title: Optimal Allocation of Embedding Dimensions under Finite-Sample Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.24592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The embedding dimension of categorical predictors is usually selected through heuristic tuning, although it directly affects model complexity, approximation quality, and finite-sample generalization. This paper formulates embedding dimension selection as a constrained allocation problem. The main contribution is to show that embedding capacity can be allocated across heterogeneous categorical predictors according to an explicit approximation-estimation tradeoff. We characterize approximation error through the singular-value tail of the latent category representation, while estimation error increases with total embedding complexity. Under a fixed global embedding budget and a tractable approximation model, this leads to a closed-form allocation rule in which the dimension assigned to each predictor is proportional to the square root of its approximation value relative to its parameter cost. translated_title: 有限样本约束下嵌入维度的最优分配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24592v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：分类预测器的嵌入维度通常通过启发式调整来选择，尽管它直接影响模型复杂度、逼近质量和有限样本泛化能力。本文将嵌入维度选择问题形式化为一个受约束的分配问题。主要贡献在于表明，嵌入容量可以根据显式的逼近-估计权衡在不同类别的分类预测器之间进行分配。我们通过潜在类别表示的奇异值尾部来刻画逼近误差，而估计误差则随总嵌入复杂度的增加而增加。在固定的全局嵌入预算和可处理的逼近模型下，这导致了一个闭式分配规则，其中分配给每个预测器的维度与其逼近值相对于其参数成本的平方根成正比。仿真实验支持所提出的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在有限样本约束下，根据逼近-估计权衡，通过闭式规则将嵌入维度按平方根比例分配给不同分类预测器的最优分配方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal allocation method for embedding dimensions under finite-sample constraints, using a closed-form rule that assigns dimensions proportionally to the square root of each predictor's approximation value relative to its parameter cost based on an approximation-estimation tradeoff.
